Jason Markey, owner and pharmacist

A locally owned chemist inside Pacific Fair

Priceline Pharmacy Pacific Fair is an independently owned Priceline Pharmacy franchise store on the ground floor of Pacific Fair Shopping Centre (Pac Fair) in Broadbeach. Whether you’re filling a script, getting a flu shot on your lunch break or after skincare that copes with the Gold Coast climate, our pharmacists and beauty advisors take the time to get it right.

Why locals choose us

  • Here since 2009, pharmacist-owned. Ask our pharmacists anything, no appointment needed.
  • Scripts ready in minutes, thanks to our robotic dispensary. Send yours ahead.
  • Walk-in vaccinations, including flu shots, free for eligible people under the National Immunisation Program, with no service fee.
  • GPs in store at Help Medical, an independent general practice located inside our store, with bulk billing for eligible patients.
Meet the team

Find us on the ground floor

Shop 81, Pacific Fair Shopping Centre, Hooker Blvd, Broadbeach QLD 4218. Ground floor, north-eastern side of the centre. Next to Proud Smile, near the outdoor entrance from the river. Park in the Orange car park, directly under us. Gate 7 is the closest entry, and the first 4 hours are free. The Broadbeach South light rail stop is right out the front.

What we can help with

Most of our services are walk-in, so there’s no need to book. See the full list of pharmacy services.

  • Ear piercing Both ears, with earrings and antiseptic spray included. $65, walk in. About ear piercing
  • Walk-in vaccinations Flu, COVID-19, whooping cough, shingles, RSV, pneumococcal and travel vaccines. Walk in or book. About vaccinations
  • Doctor's appointment An independent general practice located inside our store. Bulk billing for eligible patients, QML pathology collection, walk-ins welcome. About Help Medical
  • Passport photos Australian and overseas passport and visa photos while you wait. $25. About passport photos
  • UTI treatment Assessment and treatment for uncomplicated bladder infections, women 18 to 65. About UTI treatment
  • Contraception consults Start, change or continue the pill, ring or injection with a trained pharmacist. $35. About contraception
  • Click & Collect Shop online at priceline.com.au and collect from us, usually within 15 minutes. About Click & Collect
  • Medication packing Your medicines sorted by day and time in weekly blister packs. About medication packing

Beauty, makeup and fragrance, with advice built for the Gold Coast

The full Priceline beauty range is here on the ground floor: makeup from NYX, Maybelline, L’Oréal Paris, Revlon, e.l.f. and Milani, lit fragrance cabinets of designer and celebrity scents, and skincare that copes with strong sun, humidity and salt water. Our beauty advisors help you match a shade, find a scent or choose a gift, with no booking and no charge.

  • Makeup, skincare, hair care and self-tan
  • Designer and celebrity fragrance, with testers in store and gift help
  • Free advice from trained beauty advisors
  • Shop in store, or order for Click & Collect and Uber Eats delivery

See a GP without leaving the store

Help Medical, an independent general practice located inside our store, bulk bills eligible patients and welcomes walk-ins, subject to doctor availability. See a doctor, then have your script filled a few steps away. QML Pathology collects inside Help Medical on weekday mornings.

Book a GP About Help Medical

Quick answers

Where is Priceline Pharmacy inside Pacific Fair?

Shop 81 on the ground floor, north-eastern side of the centre, next to Proud Smile and near the outdoor entrance from the river. Park in the Orange car park, directly under us (Gate 7 is closest). The prescription counter is at the back of the store on the left. Get directions and parking tips.

Are you open on Sundays?

Yes. We’re open 7 days a week, and until 9pm on Thursdays. Public holiday hours are updated on our Google listing. See our full opening hours.

Do I need an appointment for a vaccination?

No. Walk in any day we’re open, including for flu shots, and scan the QR code at the counter to join the queue, or book a time online if you’d rather not wait. Weekday mornings, from 8am to 10am, are usually our quietest time.

Is there a doctor inside the pharmacy?

Yes. Help Medical is an independent general practice located inside our store, with bulk billing for eligible patients. Walk in subject to doctor availability, or book a GP ahead.

Can I send my prescription before I arrive?

Yes. Email your eScript to pharmacy@pricelinepf.com.au, or send it through the Priceline Pharmacy app or MedAdvisor, and we’ll have it ready to collect. Send a script ahead.
